ownership.quote: Mistral AI, the French company last valued at $13.8 billion, has made its first acquisition. The OpenAI competitor has agreed to buy Koyeb, a Paris-based startup that simplifies AI app deployment at scale and manages the infrastructure behind it.

stage.quote: Koyeb had raised $8.6 million to date, including a $1.6 million pre-seed round in 2020, followed in 2023 by a $7 million seed round led by Paris-based VC firm Serena
stage.note: Last priced round was the 2023 seed round; the company was subsequently acquired by Mistral AI in Feb 2026 (deal terms undisclosed), so it is now a subsidiary of Mistral AI going forward.

total_funding_usd.basis: TechCrunch reported total raised to date at time of acquisition
total_funding_usd.quote: Koyeb had raised $8.6 million to date, including a $1.6 million pre-seed round in 2020, followed in 2023 by a $7 million seed round led by Paris-based VC firm Serena

last_round.quote: followed in 2023 by a $7 million seed round led by Paris-based VC firm Serena, whose principal Floriane de Maupeou celebrated the acquisition

note: Koyeb was founded in 2020 by three former Scaleway employees. It was acquired by Mistral AI in February 2026 (Mistral's first acquisition) to accelerate Mistral Compute; deal terms were undisclosed. Koyeb's platform continues operating but is now focused on enterprise clients, and new signups for its Starter tier were discontinued. Koyeb Sandboxes (the product on this card) launched shortly before the acquisition.
